title: Billing Line Item Updated
description: A committed Milkshake ledger event moved one of a client's customer lines (a statement label and its total) for an open or issued period. One event per moved line, after the ledger event's own announcement: the client's lines are built just before and at the event and compared by label total. Open: no active statement covers the period yet (the UTC calendar month the change was committed in, or the month before it, the one being closed). Issued: an active statement covers it, so the change makes that statement stale; number names it. Never a vendor, a rule or a boi (a customer label never names a vendor). Imported history moves nothing. Emitted by the milkshake-outbox after the ledger commit; the id is a uuid5 of the ledger hash, period and label, so a re-publish is the same event. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (billing).

client.description: Client slug whose customer line moved.

ledger_seq.description: Seq of the ledger event that moved the line.

ledger_type.description: The ledger event type that moved it, e.g. boi.recorded, rule.added, scope.reviewed.

actor.description: Who recorded that ledger event (MILKSHAKE_ACTOR, or farm:<email>).

period.description: YYYY-MM for a calendar month, else YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive last day).

label.description: The customer line's label as the statement shows it (never a vendor name).

previous_cents.description: The line's total in integer cents just before the ledger event; null when the line did not exist.

amount_cents.description: The line's total in integer cents at the ledger event; null when the line went.

state.description: open: no active statement covers the period yet; issued: an active statement does, and the change makes it stale.

number.description: The active statement covering the period (issued only), else null.

as_of_seq.description: The ledger seq the new amount is as of (the ledger event's own seq).
